abstract: Published online: 08 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-76539-8 Aqueous zinc-bromine batteries face a trade-off between capacitive power and redox capacity. Here, authors design cavity enabled supramolecular that dynamically switch from ion storage at low voltages to polybromide stabilization at high voltages, delivering high capacity, power and cycling durability.
